primary: Spearman activity correlation per dataset, author-defined positive efficacy orientation
CI: 1000 guide-row percentile bootstraps with seeds0..999; observed rows may share genes; source-style not independent-target generalization CI
rank_loss: source-style within-gene mean absolute rank difference; 4 genomewide datasets only
ndcg: SUPPLEMENTAL not an original RS3 metric; linear within-gene percentile-rank relevance, k=min(20,n), tie-averaged sklearn ndcg_score; not interchangeable with previous binary-top20 metric
cohort_note: 23629 unique contexts match publication; current per-dataset row totals differ from cached notebook annotations, recorded rather than force-adjusted
